axes.name: Useful discovery, competing/analogous approaches, implementation/history and opportunity breadth
axes.assessment: Discovery is substantive: separate units/outcomes, field/vocabulary/locality mismatch, citation seed dependence, portal metadata/access failures, curator geographic/language bias, conservative relation-based candidates and screening defaults. Competing lexical, repository/citation and curator routes are discriminated with yield/workload/identity outcomes. Index collection launch/cutover and software issue/fix histories are meaningful analogous implementations; dated review methods give bounded related-collection leads. No arbitrary winner or vacuous “investigate later” substitutes for mechanisms. Municipal histories/controlled-vocabulary mechanisms remain less developed, within explicitly open scope.

axes.name: Wrong criticism, corrections/rejections and exact plan dispositions
axes.assessment: All C-01–C-05 were individually reassessed. C-02 is a real material draft inconsistency and is corrected. C-04’s field-scope correction is valid. C-05 properly retains access uncertainty. C-01/C-03 overstate an optional design opportunity; the final’s voluntary two-index design is defensible but its original-obligation attribution is inaccurate. Rejected shortcuts are within the original boundaries; no source-backed valid method is wrongly prohibited as a winner. Exact plan text and individual dispositions are preserved in plan-clause-map.json and the markdown matrix.

axes.name: Supported meaning preserved across discovery/draft/critique/final
axes.assessment: The final is self-contained and retains substantive units, variants/aliases, complementary sources, IDs/provenance, relation uncertainty, version history, conservative links, probability screening, separate workload/yield/identity outcomes, owner decisions, rejected shortcuts and proposed/executed distinctions. It preserves stable S-identities with attached critic/reviser observations rather than silently rebinding them. The draft effort defect is corrected without erasing its lineage. Optional blinded noncandidate-pair wording is compressed, and the ASReview anecdote is properly qualified in the final.

axes.name: Meaningful proposed versus executed validation and oracle applicability
axes.assessment: Executed case searches, record export, screening, matching, empirical coverage/workload validation and outcome analysis are not claimed. Stage maps report documentation desk checks; their historical execution traces are not independently authenticated. Proposed validation has scope/query/route/time freeze, disjoint effort, candidate inclusions plus sampled exclusions, pair adjudication, frame probabilities, independent manual leads, bounded uncertainty and discriminating study-level/marginal/workload outcomes. Curator, union, overlap, DOI and software flags are not gold standards. Human adjudication is a bounded oracle with unresolved labels, not established truth. No statistical estimator or software accuracy is validated by this review.
